content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi, I’m having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone. It’s been happening for the past few hours. Can you help me get this fixed?
Error: Tool 'check_sim_status' not found.

I apologize for the inconvenience. Let's try to resolve your issue. First, could you please confirm if you are able to send or receive regular SMS messages? This will help determine if the issue is specific to MMS or affects all messaging.
I’m not sure about SMS, but my main concern is with MMS messages—they just won’t send. Can you help me figure out what’s wrong with the MMS?
Error: Tool 'can_send_mms' not found.

I'm sorry for the inconvenience. Let's try another approach. First, can you check if your phone is connected to a cellular network and if mobile data is enabled? This is essential for MMS to function properly. If you're unsure how to check this, let me know, and I can guide you through it.
Status Bar: ✈️ Airplane Mode | 🔋 80%
It looks like my phone is currently in Airplane Mode. Could that be the reason why MMS isn’t working? What should I do next?
Error: Tool 'toggle_airplane_mode' not found.

I apologize for the inconvenience. Since your phone is in Airplane Mode, it's expected that MMS isn't working. Please manually turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. You can usually find this option in the settings or by swiping down from the top of the screen to access the quick settings panel. Let me know if you need further assistance after doing this.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📵 No Signal | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
I've turned off Airplane Mode, but now my phone shows "No Signal" and "Data Disabled" in the status bar. What should I do next?
Error: Tool 'toggle_data' not found.

I'm sorry for the inconvenience. Since your phone shows "Data Disabled," please manually enable mobile data in your phone's settings. You can usually find this under "Network & Internet" or "Connections." Let me know if you need further assistance after enabling mobile data.

Mobile Data is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📵 No Signal | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
I tried enabling mobile data, but it still shows as "Data Disabled" and "No Signal" in the status bar. Is there something else I should try?
Error: Tool 'reseat_sim_card' not found.

I'm sorry for the inconvenience. Since your phone is showing "No Signal," it might be an issue with the SIM card. Please try removing the SIM card and reinserting it properly. Ensure it's seated correctly in the SIM tray. Let me know if this helps or if you need further assistance.

SIM card re-seated successfully.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
I’ve reinserted the SIM card. Now my phone shows a poor signal on 2G and data is still disabled. What should I do next?
Error: Tool 'set_network_mode_preference' not found.

I apologize for the inconvenience. Since your phone is currently on 2G, which is not suitable for MMS, you'll need to change the network mode preference to allow 4G or 5G. You can usually find this option under "Network & Internet" or "Mobile Network" settings. Look for "Preferred Network Type" or a similar option and select "4G/5G" or "4G LTE." Let me know if you need further assistance after making this change.

Preferred Network Mode set to: 4g_5g_preferred
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
I've changed the network mode to prefer 4G/5G, and now my phone shows an excellent 5G signal, but data is still disabled. What should I do next?
Error: Tool 'reset_apn_settings' not found.

I'm sorry for the inconvenience. Since your phone is now on 5G but data is still disabled, you may need to reset the APN (Access Point Name) settings. This can usually be found under "Network & Internet" or "Mobile Network" settings. Look for an option to "Reset to Default" or "Restore APN Settings." After resetting, restart your phone to apply the changes. Let me know if you need further assistance after doing this.

APN settings will reset at reboot.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%

Resetting APN settings...
Restarting network services...
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
I’ve reset the APN settings and restarted my phone, but the status bar still shows data is disabled. Is there something else I should try? This is getting a bit frustrating.

I understand this is frustrating. Since the data is still disabled, it might be an issue with your account or line status. Could you please provide me with your phone number or customer ID so I can look up your account and check if there are any issues on our end? This will help me assist you more effectively.
My phone number is 555-123-2002. Can you check if there’s anything wrong on your end?
